arguments.content: Final Answer: The table presents the standings of 12 teams in the Tallangatta DFL (District Football League), showing their performance metrics for a season. The columns include: team names, wins (number of games won), byes (games not played, all 0 in this table), losses (number of games lost), draws (tied games, all 0), and against (total points scored against each team). Notable trends include Kiewa Sandy Creek and Tallangatta Valley tied at the top with 16 wins each, while Wodonga Saints and Chiltern are at the bottom with only 1 win each. There is a clear inverse correlation between wins and points against - teams with more wins generally have lower "against" totals, indicating stronger defensive performance. Kiewa Sandy Creek has the best defensive record (1013 points against) while Chiltern has the worst (2535 points against).
